TREVOR DANIEL
FUND ACCOUNTING | FUND ADMINISTRATION | TRADE PROCESSING | SECURITIES OPERATIONS
Bangalore, India | trevdan007@gmail.com | +91 9867511063 | linkedin.com/in/trevordaniel
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Fund Accounting and Securities Operations professional with 4+ years of hands-on experience across Fund Accounting, Fund
Administration and the complete Trade Lifecycle. Experienced in hands-on NAV calculation and validation, trade enrichment,
pre-upload validation, bulk trade uploads, trade capture, trade processing, trade booking, trade affirmation/confirmation, SWIFT
instructions and transmissions, trade settlement, reconciliations and settlement-fail management. Strong experience investigating
STP breaks, security setup gaps and SSI-related exceptions before and after uploads. Exposure to Equities, Fixed Income, F&O;,
listed securities and OTC derivatives including IRS, CDS, OTC Options, Variance and Volatility Swaps. Experienced in global client
operations, onshore teams, counterparties, trustees and internal stakeholders while maintaining operational controls, accuracy and
timely processing.

 Fund Accounting

OTC & Listed Products

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
HSBC — Fund Admin Supervisor Sep 2025 – Apr 2026
  Performed hands-on Fund Accounting and Fund Administration activities, including daily NAV calculation and validation and
 related operational checks.
 Performed hands-on trade processing across the lifecycle, including trade enrichment, pre-upload validation, bulk uploading, trade
 capture/booking, confirmation/affirmation and downstream processing.
 Worked hands-on with SWIFT instructions/transmissions as part of the trade flow, understanding how trade details and settlement
 instructions move through downstream processing.
 Performed pre-upload validations to identify data-quality issues, security setup gaps and SSI-related exceptions and reduce STP
 breaks before bulk upload.
 Investigated and resolved operational/STP breaks, trade and cash breaks, discrepancies and exceptions affecting fund accounting
 and trade processing.
 Processed and booked OTC trades including IRS, CDS and options as part of the end-to-end trade lifecycle.
  Performed cash and trade reconciliations with the Trustee and validated postings for accuracy and completeness.
  Performed due-diligence and monitoring checks on postings, signed off journals and trades, and supported operational control
 requirements.
 Supported high-volume bulk uploading of fund/trade data and ensured timely and accurate downstream processing.
  Worked with onshore teams to investigate client concerns and resolve operational issues within agreed timelines.
 CSC Global — Associate Dec 2024 – Sep 2025
  Performed trade settlement processing, settlement oversight and settlement-fail management across OTC and listed products.
  Supported the complete trade lifecycle from trade capture/booking and affirmation through settlement, reconciliation and exception
 resolution.
 Affirmed OTC trades on ICE to minimize trade breaks during settlement.
  Executed OTC bookings and listed trades including IRS Swaps, Variance and Volatility Swaps, OTC Options, CFDs and CDSs on
 Enfusion.
 Supported cash/payment processing, margin-call negotiations with banks and reconciliation-related activities.
  Mapped OTC trades to support valuation, risk and P&L; monitoring and investigated reporting breaks through corrective actions
 with Trading and Sales teams.
 Performed security setup based on OTC trade requirements.
 
Enfusion — Senior Analyst Aug 2021 – Jun 2024
  Worked across the complete trade lifecycle including trade booking, trade capture, trade affirmation, settlement and reconciliation
 across Equities, Fixed Income, Swaps, Futures and Options.
 Supported Fund Administration activities including fund setup, client onboarding and coordination with Static, Implementation and
 Account Management teams.
 Performed reconciliations and analyzed daily breaks, identifying trends and coordinating corrective actions to reduce operational
 exceptions.
 Managed client requests and coordinated with Account Managers and cross-functional teams through Zendesk and Jira.
  Created a KPI dashboard to improve operational visibility and monitor processing timeliness and service performance.
  Managed client allocation based on volumes and training requirements and escalated process deviations to management.
  Onboarded 3 new clients and supported setup of 5 existing funds.
  Created SOPs for training and SOC audit purposes and supported process improvements focused on compliance and operational
 risk.

Operations: Fund Accounting, NAV Calculation & Validation, Fund Administration, Trade Enrichment, Trade Capture, Trade
Booking, Trade Processing, Trade Affirmations/Confirmations, SWIFT Instructions, Pre-Upload Validation, Bulk Uploading, Trade
Settlement, Settlement Fails, Cash & Position Reconciliation, ISDA & FCM Reconciliation, Collateral Management, STP Break
Investigation and Operational Controls.
